theorem nativeRecordsReconcileWithoutFlatteningListedUnits :
    let nativePipeRecordCount : Nat := 167
    let uniqueListingDefinitionCount : Nat := 165
    let listingFabricatedUnitCount : Nat := 169
    let unexpandedListingUnitCount := listingFabricatedUnitCount - nativePipeRecordCount
    And (nativePipeRecordCount > uniqueListingDefinitionCount) (unexpandedListingUnitCount = 2) :=
by decide

theorem listingCrosswalkDoesNotPromoteFabrication :
    let nativeRowToListingDefinitionReady : Bool := true
    let exactThreadedLengthMatchCount : Nat := 67
    let weldedCutLengthCrossSourceReady : Bool := false
    let listingQuantityExpansionReady : Bool := false
    let pieceToPlanMappingReady : Bool := false
    let fabricationReady := nativeRowToListingDefinitionReady && exactThreadedLengthMatchCount = 67 && weldedCutLengthCrossSourceReady && listingQuantityExpansionReady && pieceToPlanMappingReady
    fabricationReady = false :=
by decide
